firstPlayerRule: Each player rolls the six black dice. Whoever rolls the most claw results takes the first turn.
officialTieBreak: If players are tied for the most claws, only those players roll again until one has the most.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise. The first player enters Tokyo City during their turn because it is initially empty.
